items.title: Police investigating new message in search for mother of Savannah Guthrie
items.title_zh: 警方调查新消息 寻找萨凡纳·古斯里的母亲
items.summary: Police are investigating a new message sent to a local TV news station that might be linked to the suspected abduction of the mother of US news presenter Savannah Guthrie.
items.summary_zh: 警方正在调查向当地一家电视台发送的新信息,可能与涉嫌绑架美国新闻主持人Savannah Guthrie的母亲有关。

items.title: The woman tasked with kicking Australian kids off social media
items.title_zh: 那个负责把澳大利亚孩子踢出社交媒体的女人
items.summary: The interview with Julie Inman Grant is yet to start - she is not even in the room - when the conversation turns to the barrage of death and rape threats her office deals with on a weekly basis.
items.summary_zh: 与Julie Inman Grant的访谈尚未开始----她甚至不在房间里----当谈话转向每周处理的死亡和强奸威胁时。

items.title: France investigates ex-minister Jack Lang over Epstein links
items.title_zh: 法国调查前部长杰克·朗的Epstein联系
items.summary: Financial crime prosecutors in France say they have opened a preliminary inquiry into former Culture Minister Jack Lang over his links to Jeffrey Epstein.
items.summary_zh: 法国金融犯罪检察官说,他们已经对前文化部长杰克·朗(Jack Lang)与杰弗里·爱泼斯坦(Jeffrey Epstein)的联系展开初步调查.

items.title: Alleged mastermind among four arrested after Pakistan mosque blast
items.title_zh: 在巴基斯坦清真寺爆炸后被捕的4人中据称是主谋
items.summary: Four people have been arrested on suspicion of facilitating a suicide bombing that killed more than 30 people on Friday, Pakistan's interior minister has said.
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦内政部长说,有4人因涉嫌促成一起自杀爆炸而被捕,该爆炸星期五造成30多人死亡。

items.title: Italy says railways hit by 'serious sabotage' as Winter Olympics begin
items.title_zh: 意大利表示,随着冬奥会的开始,铁路受到"严重的破坏"打击.
items.summary: Suspected attacks on northern Italy's railway network have led to severe travel disruption in the region, the authorities say, as thousands gathered for the start of the Winter Olympic Games.
items.summary_zh: 当局称,怀疑袭击意大利北部铁路网已导致该地区严重出行中断,成千上万人聚集参加冬季奥林匹克运动会开幕式.

items.title: 'I don't want to imagine what happened' - Shock and disbelief in area Nancy Guthrie went missing
items.title_zh: "我不想想象发生了什么" - Nancy Guthrie失蹤地區的震驚和懷疑
items.summary: The neighbourhood where Nancy Guthrie went missing has breathtaking views of the Santa Catalina mountains and strict limits on outdoor lighting to protect Tucson's standing as a stargazer's paradise.
items.summary_zh: Nancy Guthrie失踪的街区对圣卡塔琳娜山脉有着令人叹为观止的看法,对室外照明也有着严格的限制来保护图克森站立于星座的天堂.

items.title: General shot in Moscow conscious after surgery, Russian media say
items.title_zh: 外科手术后在莫斯科中枪的将军 俄罗斯媒体说
items.summary: A Russian general who was shot several times in Moscow on Friday has regained consciousness after successfully undergoing surgery, according to reports in Russian media.
items.summary_zh: 根据俄罗斯媒体的报道,一名星期五在莫斯科被多次枪杀的俄罗斯将领在成功接受手术后恢复了知觉.

items.title: US wants Russia and Ukraine to end war by June, says Zelensky
items.title_zh: Zelensky说,美国希望俄罗斯和乌克兰在6月结束战争
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky says the US wants the war with Russia to end by June, adding both sides had been invited to the US for talks next week.
items.summary_zh: 乌克兰总统沃洛德米尔·泽连斯基表示,美国希望与俄罗斯的战争能于6月结束,他补充说,双方都被邀请到美国参加下周的谈判。

items.title: S Korean crypto firm accidentally pays out $40bn in bitcoin
items.title_zh: 韩国密码公司不小心用比特币付了40块
items.summary: A South Korean cryptocurrency exchange accidentally gave away more than $40bn (£32bn) worth of bitcoin to customers, briefly making them multi-millionaires.
items.summary_zh: 韩国的密码货币交易所意外地将价值超过40bn(32bn英镑)的比特币送给客户,短暂地使他们成为了数百万富翁.

items.title: Zambian leader backs traditional Ghanaian outfit after online trolling
items.title_zh: 赞比亚领导人支持传统加纳服装,
items.summary: Zambia's president has weighed into a cultural debate that has erupted online after the president of Ghana arrived in Zambia wearing a traditional outfit called a fugu. Some Zambians mockingly called it a "blouse".
items.summary_zh: 赞比亚总统身穿传统服装, 一些赞比亚人嘲弄地称其为"blouse".

items.title: Trump threatens tariffs for countries trading with Iran
items.title_zh: 特朗普威胁对伊朗贸易国家的关税
items.summary: US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order threatening to impose additional tariffs on countries that continue to trade with Iran.
items.summary_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普已签署行政命令,威胁对继续同伊朗贸易的国家加征关税.

items.title: At the scene of deadly Pakistan mosque explosion
items.title_zh: 在致命的巴基斯坦清真寺爆炸现场
items.summary: At least 31 people have been killed and almost 170 injured after a suicide bomber detonated a device at a Shia mosque, according to police.
items.summary_zh: 据警方称,一名自杀炸弹手在什叶派清真寺引爆了一枚装置,造成至少31人死亡,近170人受伤.

items.title: Colorado funeral home director sentenced to 40 years for corpse abuse
items.title_zh: 科罗拉多州殡仪馆馆长因虐待尸体被判处40年徒刑
items.summary: The co-owner of a Colorado funeral home where nearly 200 decaying bodies were found has been sentenced to 40 years in prison for corpse abuse.
items.summary_zh: 科罗拉多州一家殡仪馆的共同所有人,在那里发现了近200具腐烂的尸体被以虐待尸体罪判处了40年监禁.

items.title: Can the US help Iran? What Iranians say - inside and outside the country
items.title_zh: 美国能帮助伊朗吗? 伊朗人说什么 国内外
items.summary: For Mojdeh and her husband, the question of US intervention in Iran is personal.
items.summary_zh: 对Mojdeh和她的丈夫来说,美国干预伊朗的问题属于个人问题。

items.title: What we still don't know about the disappearance of Savannah Guthrie's mother
items.title_zh: 关于萨凡纳·古斯里的母亲失踪 我们还不知道的
items.summary: Nearly a week since the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, the mother of US news presenter Savannah Guthrie, police are investigating a new message sent to a local news station. It comes after the first deadline from an alleged ransom letter passed on Thursday evening.
items.summary_zh: 美国新闻主持人Savannah Guthrie的母亲Nancy Guthrie失踪近一周后, 这是在星期四晚上通过据称的赎金信的第一个最后期限之后提出的。

items.title: Trump says he 'didn't see' part of video with racist clip depicting Obamas as apes
items.title_zh: 特朗普说,他"没有看到"部分的视频,带有种族主义的片段将奥巴马描绘为猿人.
items.summary: US President Donald Trump has said he "didn't see" the part of a social media video which showed a racist clip depicting Barack and Michelle Obama as apes.
items.summary_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)表示自己"没有看到"一个社交媒体视频中,

items.title: The retired Indian factory worker who built a library of two million books
items.title_zh: 那个退休的印度工厂工人 建造了200万本书的图书馆
items.summary: Two million books, housed across a sprawling building, free for anyone to borrow and read.
items.summary_zh: 两百万本书,存放在一栋无所不在的建筑上,任何人都可以免费借阅.

items.title: From Hollywood to the homeland: Why African countries are courting black American stars
items.title_zh: 从好莱坞到祖国:非洲国家为何追求美国黑人明星.
items.summary: Although their forefathers were seized from West and Central Africa centuries ago, the bond between African-Americans and their ancestral home has been a lasting one.
items.summary_zh: 虽然他们的祖先在几个世纪前就被从西非和中非夺取了,但非裔美国人与其祖先家园之间的纽带是持久的。

items.title: Could Bad Bunny set off political fireworks at the Super Bowl half-time show?
items.title_zh: Bad Bunny在超级杯半场秀上 会不会引爆政治烟花?
items.summary: Two American football teams - the Seattle Seahawks and New England Patriots - will vie for the championship title on Sunday during Super Bowl LX. But mid-game there's a separate, equally high-profile battle brewing: a culture war.
items.summary_zh: 美国有两支足球队——西雅图海鹰队和新英格兰爱国者队——将在超级碗LX赛期间于星期天参加冠军头衔的争夺. 但中场有单独出场,同样高调的战斗酿造:一场文化之战.

items.title: They were drawn to Korea with dreams of K-pop stardom - but then let down
items.title_zh: 他们带着K-pop明星的梦想被吸引到韩国,但后来却失望了
items.summary: As K-pop's popularity soars, South Korea has become a destination for young people around the world hoping to break into the industry.
items.summary_zh: 随着K-pop的受欢迎程度飙升,韩国成为了全世界希望打入产业的年轻人的目的地.

items.title: Will Sunday's snap election gamble pay off for Japan's first female premier?
items.title_zh: 星期天的竞选赌博会给日本首届女首秀带来回报吗?.
items.summary: Japan heads to the polls again on Sunday for its second general election in as many years. The snap vote has caught the ruling party, the opposition and much of the electorate off guard.
items.summary_zh: 日本在星期日再次举行投票, 迅速的投票使执政党、反对党和多数选民失去警惕。

items.title: Watch: Trump has called to nationalise US elections. Is it a big deal?
items.title_zh: 观察:特朗普呼吁美国选举国有化. 有大事吗?
items.summary: US President Donald Trump has urged Republicans to "nationalise" elections while repeating his false claims of 2020 election fraud in a podcast interview.
items.summary_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普敦促共和党将选举"国有化",同时在播客采访中重复他关于2020年选举舞弊的虚假说法.

items.title_zh: 米兰-科蒂纳运动会从充满活力的开幕式开始

items.title: Gazans returning through Rafah crossing describe checks by Palestinian militia
items.title_zh: 通过拉法过境点返回的加沙人描述了巴勒斯坦民兵的检查情况
items.summary: Two Gazan women who passed through the newly reopened Rafah crossing with Egypt on Monday have told the BBC that a local Palestinian militia linked to Israel carried out checks at an Israeli military checkpoint inside the Gaza Strip.
items.summary_zh: 两名加沙妇女星期一通过与埃及新重新开放的拉法过境点,告诉英国广播公司,与以色列有联系的当地巴勒斯坦民兵在加沙地带内的一个以色列军事检查站进行检查。

items.title: Watch: Ukrainian soldier thought to be dead calls his family
items.title_zh: 观察:乌克兰士兵认为死了,
items.summary: This is the moment Nazar Daletskyi’s family found out that their relative, who was thought to have died fighting as a Ukrainian soldier in the first year of Russia’s full-scale invasion, was in fact alive.
items.summary_zh: 这时纳扎尔·达列茨基伊的家人发现,他们的亲戚在俄罗斯全面入侵的第一年中被认为作为乌克兰士兵而战死,实际上还活着.

items.title: Coin portrait of late Queen draws criticism in Australia
items.title_zh: 澳大利亚已故女王的铜像画出批评
items.summary: Two commemorative coins, released by the Royal Australian Mint and bearing a portrait of Queen Elizabeth II, have been criticised for their lack of resemblance to the late monarch.
items.summary_zh: 两枚由澳大利亚皇家明德发行并刻有女王伊丽莎白二世肖像的纪念币被批评为与已故君主没有相似之处.

items.title: Watch: The US and Russia's nuclear treaty is dead. What comes next?
items.title_zh: 央视:美俄核条约已死. 接下来怎么办?
items.summary: The New START Treaty, initially signed by the United States and Russia in 2010, continued a string of nuclear arms control agreements between the two countries stretching back to 1991.
items.summary_zh: 最初由美国和俄罗斯于2010年签署的《新裁武条约》延续了两国之间一系列可追溯到1991年的核军备控制协定。
